macros.name: MakeCarderockDivPage
macros.doc: The macro \MakeCarderockDivPage will create a Technical Components page that lists the major Carderock Division technical components of the organization along with the three types of reports issued by this division.

macros.name: MakeNavyTitlePage
macros.doc: The \MakeNavyTitlePage command creates the Report Title Page using the information defined by the associated field macros.

macros.name: NavyFormID
macros.doc: The macro \NavyFormID{FormID} is defined so a form identifier can be placed at the bottom of a page.

macros.name: NavyMarginTitle
macros.doc: The macro \NavyMarginTitle is defined so an optional title can appear in the left hand margin of the cover page, oriented in a vertical position.

macros.name: NavyReportNumber
macros.doc: The \NavyReportNumber command is defined so the user can use it to both specify and retrieve the report number.

macros.name: NavyTitlePage
macros.doc: The macro \NavyTitlePage will produce a title page for the Navy technical report on a separate page at the location where it appears.
